summary: Apply QGIS and LADM concepts to parcel quality, tenure linkage and land planning. Explore the cadastral GIS training course.
lede: Cadastral GIS connects parcel maps with tenure records for land administrators, cadastral officers and GIS managers who maintain and use land information. The course covers linking tenure records to parcel geometries, checking data quality and boundary issues in QGIS, and preparing valuation and service-access maps to support operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who maintain land records, analyse parcel information or use cadastral evidence to guide property and public-service decisions. It is designed for people with working familiarity with maps or land records who need to connect spatial data with institutional workflows.
audience: Municipal planners using parcel analysis to locate
prerequisites: Working familiarity with maps, land records or GIS workflows is expected. No coding is required. A laptop with QGIS installed is needed for the practical GIS exercises; confirm installation and file compatibility before delivery.
